description: Formal types from 'The Mathematical Structure of IIT'. Use these as Lean targets for IIT claims.

items.name: St
items.signature: St(S) : Set — states of system S

items.name: Subs
items.signature: Subs(S) ⊂ Sys — subsystems with induced state s|M

items.name: Cut
items.signature: S^z, s^z — cut system and cut state for z ∈ DS

items.name: caus
items.signature: caus_s(M,P) ∈ PE(S) with decomposition over D_M,P

items.name: eff
items.signature: eff_s(M,P) ∈ PE(S) with decomposition over D_M,P

items.name: phi
items.signature: φ(e) = min_{z≠1} d(e, ē(z)) — integration level

items.name: Concept
items.signature: CS,s(M) = core integration scaling of (caus(M), eff(M))

items.name: ActualExperience
items.signature: E(S,s) = core integration scaling of Q(S,s)

items.name: Cut
items.signature: T^(M,M⊥) replaces M⊥→M edges with uniform noise
